title: Independent assessment of the reflected small-radical consequence
objective: Determine exactly what the reviewed reflected-prime correlation adds to the closest primary prior work and whether it establishes a substantive breakthrough toward the user's original Goldbach objective, without treating a verification record as novelty or a sign correlation as a Goldbach bound.
deliverables: Substantive consequence versus verification and remaining gap assessment
Separate challenge and final bounded revision
success_criteria: No source claim is upgraded from abstract or metadata
H2' replacement is distinguished from proving every source claim
Restricted pointwise, average and fixed-shift conclusions are not conflated
Only the root may decide goal completion after inspecting evidence
stop_conditions: One bounded author-critic-revision round,8 proxy units
No external messages, publication or paid inference
Uncertain novelty or breakthrough status remains unverified rather than selected for convenience
